summary: Full regression pass for iteration 39: SEO homes-for-sale hubs, saved-search preview + social proof + email-preview toggle, Doogie save → double opt-in done state, internal links on community/region pages, English-only invariant, and smoke pages. 4/4 pytest backend tests passed and all frontend assertions passed via Playwright.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/src/App.js is monolithic (>10k lines) — the HomesForSale component, SaveSearchButton and RegionPage should be split into their own modules under src/pages/ for maintainability.

The `_render_saved_search_email` helper builds HTML via string concatenation with inline styles — fine for now, but consider a tiny template function with escape() for address fields even though CREA DDF data is trusted, to defend against future input sources.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified data on this run — Langley hub: 1,432 active, $974,950 median; Surrey hub: 4,397 active, $1,049,000 median; Langley Townhouse+suite preview active_count=104 (matches social-proof text '104 active listings match right now'). new_this_week was 0 everywhere (expected per task note). Each sample item in /api/saved-searches/preview includes the `just_listed` boolean key. The /homes-for-sale/zzz-not-real invalid slug renders 'Homes for sale in Zzz Not Real, BC' with 0 active + '—' median — does not crash. Community/Surrey has the community-homes-for-sale-link; /regions/fraser-valley has 4 region-hfs-* pills (Abbotsford, Chilliwack, Mission, +1). English-only invariant holds (no doogie-lang-select; /buyer?lang=fa renders English LTR). No horizontal overflow at 1920 or 390 on either hub. All critical flows: Doogie search → listings → save-open → social-proof → preview-toggle → preview card → email+consent → submit → done state all worked end-to-end.
